pr_title: Add recently opened directories to the taskbar jumplist
pr_body:
Implements and closes #1238.

**Know issues:**
- If you remove a jumplist item while the app is running, the folder will be no longer added until you restart the app.
- Drives aren't being added to the jumplist.
pr_comments: Should we add recycle bin or root directories to the taskbar jumplist?
@Jaiganeshkumaran I think so, the goal would be to allow the user to jump back to recent directories.
Can we just use the same FolderIcon for all the folders? I've converted the SVG to PNG since the jumplist API only supports bitmaps.
Should we localize the text displayed for library folders like Documents?

issue_context.title: Add recently opened directories to the taskbar jumplist
comments: @duke7553 Could you assign me on this issue?
Although File Explorer only pins quick access folders and recent folders to the taskbar jumplist, we can also pin drives as well.
@Jaiganeshkumaran I don't think we need to pin items to the taskbar jumplist. I think adding them will be enough.
Sorry, I meant by adding not pinning.
Should we only add recent folders are should we also add folders in the sidebar?
@Jaiganeshkumaran I think we should start by only adding recent folders.

For the icons, should we show monochrome icons of the color icons? It'd be much easier to use color icons since the jumplist only supports bitmaps. To display MDL2 icons we have to convert it which is not that difficult however because of the light theme in 1903 and later we have to change the icons when the theme changes.
@Jaiganeshkumaran Color icons will probably work best.

review_comments: You can use `ResourceController.GetTranslation("SidebarVideos")` instead of this

I know however when you assign the ms-resource:/// protocol to a jumplist item, Windows will automatically retrieve the string for the current language. This way we don't need to refresh the jumplist after the user changes their language. However, we need to refresh the jumplist after an update since the ms-resource:/// protocol is version dependent.

You don't need to translate group name as it should be translated by default. Look at this [link](https://github.com/microsoft/Windows-universal-samples/blob/a58c5d9b84456196889edb1f4a6e844c7a729b8b/Samples/JumpList/cs/Scenario4_ChangeSystemGroup.xaml.cs#L49).
This is for the automatic recent list which doesn't work with Files UWP since this app isn't associated with any file type.
